verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a remote-desktop product with address books, settings, and audit logs, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a data-export feature or open export formats. AGPL licensing, self-hosting, a Pro management API, and a community 'no vendor lock in' remark are adjacent openness traits or developer building blocks, not a first-party export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
